title: ExceptionResolved
description: The Planner resolved an Exception with an outcome and a remark (Canonical Model event, version 1). The Exception leaves the list of Open Exceptions. Published on the Shipment events topic, under the correlation ID of the resolution, which starts a Message trail of its own because it starts in the TMS UI; the Exception number links it to the Exception's opening.

occurredAt.description: When the Planner resolved the Exception.

correlationId.description: The resolution's own correlation ID, not the opening cause's.

transportOrderNumber.description: The Transport Order the Shipment carries out.

remark.description: What the Planner did or concluded; required for every outcome.
